messages:
Mia Ramos: quick design check — I'm iterating on the Audit Log 'access timeline' UX. idea: let users create sharable 'snapshots' (filtered + pinned time window) and provide keyboard navigation for the timeline. also accessibility: screen reader announcement when a snapshot loads. any red flags?
Alex Chen: snapshots sound useful. question on naming: 'Snapshot' vs 'Saved view' vs 'Shared view' — 'snapshot' feels compact. :+1:
Jamal Singh: agree on 'snapshot'. UI question: where does the pin/snapshot action live? next to filters or inside the time-picker? my vote: inline with filters so it's discoverable. also keyboard nav should wrap (loop) at ends.
Sam Ortiz: a11y note — when a snapshot loads announce exactly: "Snapshot loaded: <name>" and move focus to the first event in the list. otherwise screen-reader users can miss context.
Alex Chen: microcopy: empty state should read 'No events match your filters' (actionable) rather than 'No access events'. and add a small CTA to clear filters.
Mia Ramos: nice. proposed keymap for the prototype (rough):
```
j: next event
k: previous event
o: open event details
s: save snapshot
Shift+S: save snapshot as...
/: focus filter input
```
Jamal Singh: watch collisions — 's' is used in other parts of the console (search shortcut). maybe require a chord (g then s) or use capital S. we should keep consistency with global shortcuts.
Sam Ortiz: also consider disabling single-letter shortcuts when focus is in a text field. for SRs, make shortcuts opt-in in preferences so they don't surprise users.
Lina Patel: product constraint — snapshots need a link to raw logs for compliance (download / raw view). also surface retention policy on the save modal (30/90/365 days).
Mia Ramos: good call. UX for linking snapshots to roles: probably show a small badge on role events that were captured by a snapshot (optional). does that create clutter?
Alex Chen: small unobtrusive badge. on hover show 'Captured by: <snapshot name>'. keeps timeline scannable.
Jamal Singh: i'll update the Figma: add the pin next to filter chips, badges on events, and prototype keynav. aiming to push tomorrow (Thu).
Sam Ortiz: i'll draft the SR announcement strings and test with NVDA + VoiceOver. i'll also list edge cases (dynamic load, pagination). ETA Friday.
Mia Ramos: thanks! next steps: jamal -> figma + prototype; sam -> SR copy & tests; alex/lina -> review retention copy. i'll sync in design review on Friday. :memo:
DesignBenchBot: new snapshot prototype uploaded by Jamal — https://figma.redwood/snapshot-proto-172345 (preview)
